summary: @servicetitan/hammer-react preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip`, extracts and chmods it, then uses it via `execFileSync` to run a 727KB sibling file `math_init.js` shipped at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle heavily obfuscated with a rotated string-array cipher (`WV8StW`, `n7gIxM`, `hc1jfK9`) and hex-mangled identifiers, is unrelated to the advertised React design-system purpose, and is not declared in `package.json`'s `files` array (only `dist` and `CHANGELOG.md` are). Routing execution through a freshly fetched non-Node runtime bypasses Node-based tooling and hooks. The package presents itself as ServiceTitan's internal Hammer/Anvil2 design system, a pattern consistent with a dependency-confusion / namespace-squat targeting the `@servicetitan` scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
